messages.subject: Shared components model
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am working with three outcomes which are all binary coming from a cross-sectional survey data. My convolution model does better than the GLM, GLMM and ICAR and so it is the candidate model. In addition, I would like to fit a joint (shared component) model for this three outcomes in INLA but I do not know how to start. I have seen that joint modelling in INLA are mostly implemented in longitudinal and survival data and since my data is cross-sectional and does not have time variable, I am unable to proceed with joint modelling. I will kindly appreciate if someone can  please assist or help with a useful material for shared component models for binary outcomes for cross-sectional data.  Thanks.
